# @stapel/docs-react 0.3.2

Headless React flow pair for stapel-docs (contract >=0.3 <0.4) — business + state, zero visual opinion.
Built on @stapel/core: typed client + StapelApiError envelope, auth token refresh,
verification-403 interception, i18n engine, analytics facade, TanStack Query layer.

## The one right way (do this, the rest is a review/lint smell)
- No raw fetch/axios. The client is injected via <DocsProvider>/StapelConfigProvider;
  every hook and flow already carries auth, refresh, and the error envelope.
- Render errors, never try/catch them: a flow's state carries FlowError{code,params};
  render `t(code, params)` and branch on `explainDocsError(code)` remediation.
- Server state = the use* hooks (query layer); keys come only from docsQueryKeys.
- User strings = i18n keys (registerDocsI18n); never string literals.
- Sign-in UI = a headless flow component; copy it (shadcn-style) to restyle.

## Layers
api (typed client) · model (hooks, session) · flows (machines) · headless · i18n

## Documented flows (flows.json — canonical id, steps, endpoints)

## Operations (typed; use the named op, never a path string)
Request/response schema names are in manifest.json + the generated types.
Paths are relative to `/docs/api/v1/`.
- docs_api_v1_documents_content_retrieve: GET /documents/{document_id}/content
- docs_api_v1_documents_content_update: PUT /documents/{document_id}/content
- docs_api_v1_documents_create: POST /documents
- docs_api_v1_documents_destroy: DELETE /documents/{document_id}
- docs_api_v1_documents_download_retrieve: GET /documents/{document_id}/download
- docs_api_v1_documents_export_retrieve: GET /documents/{document_id}/export
- docs_api_v1_documents_list: GET /documents
- docs_api_v1_documents_partial_update: PATCH /documents/{document_id}
- docs_api_v1_documents_restore_create: POST /documents/{document_id}/restore
- docs_api_v1_documents_retrieve: GET /documents/{document_id}
- docs_api_v1_documents_revisions_content_retrieve: GET /documents/{document_id}/revisions/{revision_id}/content
- docs_api_v1_documents_revisions_create: POST /documents/{document_id}/revisions
- docs_api_v1_documents_revisions_download_retrieve: GET /documents/{document_id}/revisions/{revision_id}/download
- docs_api_v1_documents_revisions_list: GET /documents/{document_id}/revisions
- docs_api_v1_documents_revisions_restore_create: POST /documents/{document_id}/revisions/{revision_id}/restore
- docs_api_v1_documents_updates_create: POST /documents/{document_id}/updates
- docs_api_v1_documents_updates_retrieve: GET /documents/{document_id}/updates
- docs_api_v1_folders_create: POST /folders
- docs_api_v1_folders_destroy: DELETE /folders/{folder_id}
- docs_api_v1_folders_list: GET /folders
- docs_api_v1_folders_partial_update: PATCH /folders/{folder_id}
- docs_api_v1_folders_restore_create: POST /folders/{folder_id}/restore
- docs_api_v1_folders_retrieve: GET /folders/{folder_id}
- docs_api_v1_trash_empty_create: POST /trash/empty
- docs_api_v1_trash_retrieve: GET /trash
- docs_api_v1_uploads_create: POST /uploads
- docs_api_v1_uploads_finalize_create: POST /uploads/{upload_id}/finalize

## Query hooks (server state; keys come only from the key factory)
- useCreateDocument (mutation) → createDocument
- useCreateFolder (mutation) → createFolder
- useCreateRevision (mutation) → createRevision
- useDocument (query) → getDocument
- useDocumentContent (query) → getContent
- useDocuments (query) → listDocuments
- useDownloadUrl (query) → getDownloadUrl
- useExportUrl (mutation) → getDownloadUrl
- useFolders (query) → listFolders
- useFolderTree (query) → listFolders
- useRestoreRevision (mutation) → restoreRevision
- useRevisionContent (query) → getRevisionContent
- useRevisions (query) → listRevisions
- useSaveContent (mutation) → putContent
- useTrash (query) → listTrash
- useTrashActions (mutation) → emptyTrash+restoreDocument+restoreFolder
- useTrashDocument (mutation) → deleteDocument
- useTrashFolder (mutation) → deleteFolder
- useUpdateDocument (mutation) → patchDocument
- useUpdateFolder (mutation) → patchFolder
- useUpload (mutation) → createUpload+finalizeUpload+getDocument+putContent+uploadToPutUrl

## Errors (render t(code, params); UX from remediation)
74 keys (full catalog: manifest.json §errors). By remediation: fix_input 32 · retry 29 · verify 5 · wait_and_retry 5 · contact_support 2 · reauthenticate 1.
Param-bearing keys (interpolation slots matter):
- error.400.field.blank [400] → fix_input {field}
- error.400.field.does_not_exist [400] → fix_input {field}
- error.400.field.invalid [400] → fix_input {field}
- error.400.field.invalid_choice [400] → fix_input {field}
- error.400.field.max_length [400] → fix_input {field,max_length}
- error.400.field.max_value [400] → fix_input {field,max_value}
- error.400.field.min_length [400] → fix_input {field,min_length}
- error.400.field.min_value [400] → fix_input {field,min_value}
- error.400.field.null [400] → fix_input {field}
- error.400.field.required [400] → fix_input {field}
- error.400.field.unique [400] → fix_input {field}
- error.429.rate_limit [429] → wait_and_retry {retry_after_minutes}

## Analytics events (typed; defineEvent → events.json, drift-gated)
- (no app defineEvent() in this pair — its analytic events are the
  auto-instrumented flow funnels below)

## Flow funnels (auto-instrumented: flow.<id>.<step> {phase})

```tsx
// Typed event + tracked() click (the one right way; §3.1).
const planSelected = defineEvent({
  name: "pricing.plan.selected",
  description: "User picked a plan",
  props: { plan: prop.oneOf(["free", "pro", "team"], "Plan code") },
});
const { tracked } = useTracked();
<Button onClick={tracked(planSelected, { plan }, startCheckout)} />
// A click that STEPS a flow machine is already instrumented — mark it
// data-analytics="flow" instead; tracked() on top double-counts (§3.2).
```

## Snippets
```tsx
// Error rendering + remediation branch (one pattern for every pair).
const r = explainDocsError(err.code); // 'wait_and_retry' | 'verify' | ...
return <Alert action={r}>{t(err.code, err.params)}</Alert>;
```
